_doc: Path-parity matrix. Every optimization or capability, on every serving path where it applies: engaged (with evidence), na (with reason), partial/missing (with owner and impact). tests/unit/test_path_parity.py enforces it; see that test for the rules. A new optimization module or performance setting fails CI until it has a row here.

paths.batch: Round driver, the unified runner for text requests of the Qwen3.5 family (dense and MoE) and of Flash-Next (Qwen4): spec on or off, one row or many (round_driver/; replaces the speculative lane and the shared batch for them)
paths.generic: Round driver, generic layer (round_driver/generic.py): every other mlx-vlm family (Gemma, Omni thinker, ...) on the model's own upstream forward, one call per row, no drafter and no packed kernels; also the paravirtual-Metal and no-lane-matmul hosts

draft_vocab.what: Reduced draft vocabulary: draft readout over a small learned vocabulary instead of the full 248k lm_head

batch.why: used only when one row drafts (round_driver/mtp.py single=True)

generic.why: no drafter on this path

text.why: n-gram drafts need no head

draft_topk_tree.what: Reduced-vocabulary top-k for tree/lattice candidates (MTP tree, DFlash lattice)

batch.why: round driver drafts chains only

generic.why: no drafter on this path

text.why: no drafter on this path

copy_rounds.what: Prompt/context copy drafting verified by the batch-invariant verify

batch.why: Dense and MoE Qwen3.5 DFlash rows verify copy chains from a per-row CopyDrafter inside the fair 32-node budget (dflash.py join); Flash-Next DFlash rows build no copier (flashnext_dflash.py join overrides it); MTP driver rows draft through the head only

generic.why: copy proposals need only a rollback-safe batch-invariant verify, no drafter weights; no non-Qwen3.5 family has the verify

text.why: separate n-gram/suffix proposer (ngram_proposer.py, suffix_proposer.py), non-streaming greedy only, default off

generic.why: no drafter on this path

text.why: no drafter on this path

cost_aware_depth.what: Expected-tokens-per-ms draft depth instead of a fixed block

generic.why: no drafter on this path

text.why: ngram depth is its own controller

sampled_spec.what: Position-keyed sampler so sampled requests draft and equal serial sampling

text.why: n-gram speculation is greedy-only

guided_spec.what: Grammar/tool-call guide applied inside speculative verify (exact target-row masks)

batch.why: DFlash driver rows with an invariant tool-call guide draft free text and mask the call's rows (round_driver/driver.py req.guide.mask()); schema/regex/grammar guides are driver rows too and decode one token a round through their ConstraintProcessor
DFlash and MTP driver rows with logprobs draft (each window row's log-softmax is reduced on its own, driver.row_logprobs; ROUND_DRIVER.md)

penalties_in_spec.what: repetition/presence/frequency penalty, logit_bias, min_tokens, suppress, ignore_eos while drafting (ProcessorWindow: per-row processors in a serial-arithmetic verify window)

batch.why: rows with processors draft through the window when windowable (driver.py: masks, repetition, at most one frequency/presence penalty); the DFlash fast tree takes only a sole frequency/presence penalty, other processors verify on a chain

thinking_budget.what: Thinking-token budget that forces the closing marker

spec_under_concurrency.what: Speculative decoding while other requests are in flight

generic.why: no drafter on this path

text.why: single request

batch_invariant_kernels.what: Row-invariant decode/verify kernels so spec on == spec off

generic.why: no speculative path to make identical

text.why: no speculative path to make identical

lane_linear.what: TensorFold row-invariant lane matmul (M5-class tensor ops)

generic.why: Qwen3.5 layout kernels

text.why: mlx-lm stock matmul

lane_layers.what: Fused residual+RMSNorm and early async_eval inside the verify forward

batch.why: round_driver/forward.py has its own packed forward

generic.why: Qwen3.5 verifier patch

text.why: Qwen3.5 verifier patch

ragged_kv.what: Per-row-length KV and ragged decode attention (lossless layout)

generic.why: ragged_kv.supports() is true only for qwen3_5 attention; Gemma/Qwen4 keep the stock batched KV (only a warning when YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION != bf16)

text.why: single request, no batch to be ragged

kv_precision.what: KV cache precision option (lossy, user setting): VLM YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION vs text YUNSHU_KV_QUANT_BITS

batch.why: every driver row is int8 when YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION=int8: DecodeBatch slots (plain / MTP rows) and Int8KVCache rows (DFlash / plain-verify), quantized once at join; drafting and verify read the int8 KV

generic.why: YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION is silently a warning on non-Qwen3.5 attention; no KV quantization for Gemma/Qwen4

weight_quant_on_load.what: In-memory weight quantization at load (YUNSHU_QUANT_MODE / YUNSHU_QUANT_CONFIG, lossy user option)

batch.why: same

generic.why: same (bf16 Gemma/Qwen4 checkpoints are the case it was made for)

prefill_kernels.what: Qualified 27B split-invariant prompt scopes: NAX rows padded to 64, BQ32 every query length, identity-padded chunked GDN, fused conv1d+silu (no concatenate); absolute 64-aligned APC checkpoints, distinct arithmetic namespace; decode/verify unchanged (YUNSHU_PREFILL_MATMUL, YUNSHU_PREFILL_ATTENTION, YUNSHU_PREFILL_GDN)

generic.why: Qwen3.5 GDN kernels; other families prefill with stock ops

text.why: mlx-lm stock prefill (YUNSHU_PREFILL_STEP_SIZE)

apc_prefix_cache.what: Exact hybrid-checkpoint prefix cache (RAM, WARM, SSD tiers)

batch.why: the driver restores and stores exact hybrid checkpoints for every request it serves (every request of every model)

generic.why: families with a sliding-window cache get no APC except gemma4 (vlm_engine.py _build_batch_runner: model_apc_plan.restorable and (model_type == gemma4 or no sliding window)); apcomni is working on checkpoint stores

text.why: separate prefix systems (kv_prefix_cache, prompt_cache, ssd_kv_cache; YUNSHU_SSD_CACHE*) with no WARM tier or exact hybrid checkpoints

prefill_stride_rule.what: Fixed prefill stride and boundary tokens so a cache hit equals a cold prefill (exact numerics)

generic.why: stride is 0 unless spec_family and invariant kernels: hit-vs-cold numerics are not pinned for other families

text.why: own prefix cache; no chunk-aligned checkpoints
text-only model

draft_family_coverage.what: Drafter families upstream mlx-vlm ships (gemma4_assistant, eagle3, dspark, qwen4_exp_mtp, ...) reachable from the runner

batch.why: Dense Qwen3.5 family MTP or bounded-context DFlash2 only; other families retain established runner paths

generic.why: spec_select returns 'model family has no speculative path' for everything outside qwen3_5/qwen3_6/qwen3_5_moe; Qwen4 MTP is on flashnext80

text.why: Gemma-4 assistant only (YUNSHU_GEMMA4_ASSISTANT), non-streaming

batch.why: same

generic.why: same

jump_forward.what: Batch singleton grammar continuations into a target window (YUNSHU_JUMP_FORWARD, default off)

gpu_sampler.what: On-GPU Gumbel-max sampling without a per-token sync (the only temp>0 text sampler)

batch.why: same keyed Gumbel path

generic.why: same as batch

lora_adapters.what: Per-request LoRA adapter and custom logits_processors

batch.why: same

generic.why: same

idle_memory_return.what: Return idle MLX buffer pools to the OS after a request

text.why: IdleMemory is imported only by vlm_batch_runner; BatchedEngine only calls mx.clear_cache at load/stop

ple_ssd_rows.what: Per-layer n-gram embedding rows read from SSD in parallel (byte-identical to upstream), with the pack table scale applied

batch.why: PLE rows are read per row inside the packed Flash-Next step (history in the row's own ArraysCache)

text.why: PLE tables exist only in qwen4_exp (Flash-Next), which is served on the generic runner

lane_promotion.what: A lone decoding row of the shared batch moves onto the speculative lane at a step boundary (batch to lane transition). Eligible greedy or position-keyed sampled DFlash rows preserve absolute generation positions and pending token probabilities on promotion, including invariant tool guides and reporting-only rows. Unsupported processors, combined serial guides, budgets and media retain the shared batch; M5 promotion certification pending

batch.why: rows of the round driver have no shared-batch phase

generic.why: no drafter on this path

text.why: n-gram drafts need no promotion

qwen4_fused_hc.what: TensorFold flash_next fused hyper-connection + router/experts kernels for the qwen4_exp layer loop (always on for qwen4_exp; single-request plain decode 26 -> 14.4 ms)

batch.why: the packed Flash-Next step runs the fused HC + router/expert kernels once over all rows

text.why: qwen4_exp (Flash-Next) hyper-connection kernels exist only for that family, which is served on the generic runner

next_turn_rehearsal.what: Next-turn rehearsal (YUNSHU_NEXT_TURN_PREFILL): while idle after a reply, prefill the assistant reply as the next turn renders it through the last absolute 64-aligned assistant-end position on qualified 27B; preemptible per decoder-layer group (kernels/preempt.py), matching follow-ups adopt work, off disables rehearsal

batch.why: a background rehearsal is a priority < 0 row of the auxiliary driver; layer-group preemption wraps the Qwen3.5 decoder layer only (other layers run the rehearsal to its end)

generic.why: preemption wraps the Qwen3.5 decoder layer only; other families report preempt.supported() False and never rehearse (a diverging request would wait a whole atom)

text.why: text-only mlx-lm fast path has no APC checkpoints to rehearse into

gc_policy.what: Python GC policy of the VLM runner (YUNSHU_GC_POLICY=defer): freeze the startup heap and hold the collector from request arrival to the first token, so a ~110 ms generation-2 pass cannot delay the first token (27B 32K warm -2.3%)

text.why: text-only mlx-lm path does not go through the VLM runner

grammar_prewarm.what: llguidance token tables built in the background at model load (YUNSHU_GRAMMAR_PREWARM), so the first constrained request does not pay the ~1 s build

fast_top_logprobs.what: top_logprobs without a full-vocabulary argsort or per-id syncs (argpartition; one tie order everywhere: descending value, ascending id)

special_token_text.what: Special-token strings inside message text stay text when the chat template is rendered (a user cannot close their turn and open a system one); count/preview renders match generation

empty_prompt_refusal.what: A prompt that renders to zero tokens is refused (EmptyPromptError, HTTP 400 empty_prompt) before any generation state

finite_state_publish.what: A checkpoint whose recurrent state is non-finite is never stored in a prefix cache

grammar_mask_fast.what: Constrained decoding masks from the constraint's bitmask/allowed_mask, not a ~240K-id allowlist per token

generation_suppress_default.what: generation_config.json suppress_tokens is the default token mask when a request sets none

grammar_dead_end_isolation.what: A grammar dead end fails only its own request (with an error), never the other rows or a hang

cache_store_opt_out.what: Per-request cache-store opt-out (X-Yunshu-Cache-Store: off): the request reuses a cached prefix but stores nothing; the prefill plan is untouched, so its output equals a storing request's

sdpa_chunk_pre_nax.what: Query-chunked head_dim-256 long-prefill attention on M1-M4 (YUNSHU_SDPA_CHUNK, experimental, default off)

pil_channels_last.what: PIL images keep their height x width x channels layout in the Gemma 4 / EmbeddingGemma 2 image processors (a 1- or 3-pixel-tall image is not channels-first)

batch.why: image prompts never enter the driver (job.prompt_kwargs is not None)

text.why: text-only models take no images

one_token_greedy.what: A request whose filters keep one token (top_k 1, min_p 1, no XTC) decodes greedily: fused argmax, the exact speculative lane and greedy-only routes instead of a sampler over one token

budget_marker_strip.what: Claude Code's <total_tokens>N tokens left</total_tokens> budget marker (lone message, system-text tail or extra system block) is dropped before the chat template renders, so the prompt prefix stays append-only

docs_ask.what: Console docs retrieval and local engine SSE answers; request limits apply before proxy inference.

batch.why: Console request preparation only; delegates unchanged chat inference to the attached engine.

generic.why: Console request preparation only; delegates unchanged chat inference to the attached engine.

text.why: Console request preparation only; delegates unchanged chat inference to the attached engine.

ane_ffn_split.what: Opt-in lossy Neural Engine share of each dense FFN layer in single-row prompt steps (YUNSHU_ANE_FFN_SPLIT=splash, Splash scheme, W8A8 + Hadamard, IOSurface + shared-event handoff); decode, verify and short tails unchanged; APC states kept apart by the kernel id

batch.why: the round driver prefills its own fixed 512-row spans through packed forwards, not PromptProcessingBatch; the split's calibrated rows start above that

generic.why: dense Qwen3.5-family MLP only (Qwen3_5MLP class patch)

text.why: mlx-lm stock prefill; the split patches the mlx-vlm Qwen3.5 MLP

qwen4_gdn_fused.what: oMLX Qwen4 fused GDN verify plan + deferred rollback for the qwen4_exp layer loop (default)

batch.why: qwen4_exp (Flash-Next) GDN verify plan exists only for that family, which is served on the generic runner

text.why: qwen4_exp (Flash-Next) GDN verify plan exists only for that family, which is served on the generic runner

ngram_spec.what: Model-free n-gram / suffix prompt-lookup speculation (opt-in: per-request spec_decode or YUNSHU_NGRAM_DEFAULT; greedy rows)

batch.why: packed Qwen3.5 / Flash-Next windows are batch-invariant tree verifies fed by MTP or DFlash copy drafts (copy_rounds); a host n-gram window would be a second proposer there, and spec on must equal spec off

generic.why: lone-row T>1 window on the model's own forward, rejected tail cut with cache.trim; guarantee = verifier top-1 over the window (not bitwise vs T=1); concurrent rows and untrimmable caches decode plain

text.why: engine_ngram.py spec loop (greedy, non-streaming); deleted with the text path switch (T11)

draftlm_spec.what: Draft-LM speculation (YUNSHU_DRAFT_MODEL: an ordinary mlx-lm checkpoint drafts greedily; opt-in per request via spec_decode; greedy lone rows)

batch.why: packed Qwen3.5 / Flash-Next windows are batch-invariant tree verifies fed by MTP or DFlash copy drafts; a second host drafter there would break spec on == spec off

generic.why: lone-row T>1 window on the model's own forward like n-gram; the draft keeps its own per-row cache, trimmed after each chain

text.why: engine_speculative.py route (non-stream, greedy / temperature); deleted with the text path switch (T11)

gemma4_assistant_spec.what: Gemma-4 assistant drafter (YUNSHU_GEMMA4_ASSISTANT: reads the target's normed hidden state and shared K/V; opt-in per request via spec_decode; greedy lone rows)

batch.why: packed Qwen3.5 / Flash-Next windows are batch-invariant tree verifies fed by MTP or DFlash copy drafts; a second host drafter there would break spec on == spec off

generic.why: lone-row T>1 window; the layer returns the kept position's hidden state (GenericBatch.hidden); a rotating sliding-window cache that would wrap decodes plain

text.why: engine_speculative.py route (non-stream, greedy / temperature); deleted with the text path switch (T11)

exclusions.why: XTC is stateful per draw (random exclusion), no position-keyed form. Rare; keep.
A rotating cache cannot be restored at an arbitrary boundary; checkpoints at window-safe boundaries are possible (apcomni).

exclusions.a: any guide with logprobs or penalties (response-format guides draft a masked tree on the round driver; the speculative lane keeps their chain)
exclusions.b: DFlash copy islands and fast tree
ev: return _invariant_guide_kind(guide) and not logprobs and not processors
exclusions.why: Tool-call guides alone can use keyed fast-tree and copy rounds; these additional constraints retain the serial chain.
Documented early-termination bug in _stream_generate_ngram_spec; agents stream, so spec is effectively off on the text path.
By design: the runner shares one model across rows.

exclusions.a: MTP rows on the round driver
exclusions.why: The driver drafts MTP rows as a chain; the MTP tree rounds only ran through the deleted mlx-vlm single-request loop hook (deadcode-1110). Kept unwired with the MTP copy-and-graft port (MAINLINES 11-10); YUNSHU_SPEC_TREE no longer selects it.

exclusions.b: tree verify (DFlash fast tree, MTP tree)
ev: rows with logits processors run one
exclusions.why: The DFlash fast tree applies a frequency / presence penalty per window row (keyed_sampling.tree_target_rows, the serial window_row arithmetic) when it is the request's only processor, so sampled requests with the model card's presence penalty keep the tree. logit_bias, the windowed repetition penalty, min_tokens / suppress masks, any guide or logprobs with a processor, and the MTP tree still verify on the chain under exact_verify.
prompt embeddings with mrope positions are not packed by round_driver/forward.py.

duplicates.note: Three draft top-k/argmax readouts over the 248k head: DraftVocab (MTP greedy), compute_lattice_gpu argpartition (DFlash), mtp_tree argpartition (MTP tree).
duplicates.unify: One DraftReadout(hidden) -> (argmax | topk(k)) owned by the target head; every drafter calls it; DraftVocab becomes its restricted implementation.

duplicates.note: Context lookup proposers: copy_drafter (VLM lane, shared by MTP and DFlash), ngram/suffix (text path and loop). Different matching rules, cost model and acceptance statistics.
duplicates.unify: A Proposer protocol (propose(tokens, k) -> list[int], observe(accepted)) with copy_drafter as the implementation; text path gains it and drops ngram_proposer.

duplicates.note: Two draft-depth controllers: NodeBudget (lane trees/DFlash chain), adaptive_spec (legacy loop). MTP chain has none.
duplicates.unify: One expected-tokens-per-ms allocator (allocate.py form handles 1..n rows); the lane calls it with n=1.

duplicates.note: Two MTP head round implementations (lane, standalone EXPERIMENTAL backend); upstream mlx_vlm _mtp_rounds_batch is a fourth reference.
duplicates.unify: Delete the standalone backend when the lane covers its cases.

duplicates.note: Four verify/decode forwards for the same Qwen3.5 layers with their own GDN and attention handling.
duplicates.unify: One packed row forward parameterized by window shape (chain, tree, ragged rows).

duplicates.note: Two prefix-cache stacks (VLM APC with WARM/SSD tiers vs text prefix/SSD cache) and two disk-cache setting families (YUNSHU_VLM_APC_DISK* vs YUNSHU_SSD_CACHE*).
duplicates.unify: Text path moves to APC (the plan to unify text onto the runner); one disk setting family.

duplicates.note: Penalty / logit_bias / min_tokens / suppress processors written twice (text_logit_processors FrequencyPresencePenalty/LogitBias/TokenBan vs build_penalty_processors + TokenMaskProcessor).
duplicates.unify: One processor set with a verify-window (multi-row) form; both paths and speculation use it.

duplicates.note: _tool_guide / validate_forced_tools copy-pasted between the fast path and VLMEngine.
duplicates.unify: Move to tool_call_grammar.py as one function taking a tokenizer.

duplicates.note: Two budget implementations: thinking_budget.py (text), mlx_vlm ThinkingBudgetCriteria (runner).
duplicates.unify: One state machine in thinking_budget.py with a 'forced next token' query.

duplicates.note: omni_engine drives mlx-lm generate_step directly (own loop), outside the runner's APC / spec / cancel handling.
duplicates.unify: Route the Omni thinker through the runner (apcomni owns the APC restore).

qwen4_gdn_fused.why: default on both qwen4_exp layer loops; 2-bit packs keep the composed layer (no 2-bit plan tiles, identity-checked)

draft_vocab.why: The Qwen3.5-only optimized hook is not installed on qwen4; family-specific serving evidence and adaptation remain open.

draft_topk_tree.why: The Qwen3.5-only optimized hook is not installed on qwen4; family-specific serving evidence and adaptation remain open.

copy_rounds.why: copy proposals need only a rollback-safe batch-invariant verify, no drafter weights; no non-Qwen3.5 family has the verify

tree_drafts.why: Flash-Next's QSA verifier is an exact chain (a draft tree would need per-node sparse selection); DFlash rows draft chains of the drafter's best candidates

cost_aware_depth.why: the driver's cost-aware allocation runs per round (0 or 1 draft per row) but chains are capped at one draft by the two-position packed verify; block 2 decoded fastest on Flash-Next (verifykern 2026-10), deeper chains need a longer QSA-exact window

spec_under_concurrency.why: every Flash-Next row drafts with its own native MTP head on the round driver (packed verify of the pending token + one draft)

batch_invariant_kernels.why: Qwen4 uses its native Qwen4ExpBatchInvariantForward, not the Qwen3.5 class patch.

lane_linear.why: Only the unsupported affine LM head is adapted; Qwen4 GDN, QSA and experts keep family-native invariant projections.

lane_layers.why: Qwen3.5 layer layout lacks Qwen4 hyper-connections, PLE and QSA; applying that class patch would be incorrect.

ragged_kv.why: ragged_kv.supports() is true only for qwen3_5 attention; Gemma/Qwen4 keep the stock batched KV (only a warning when YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION != bf16)

kv_precision.why: YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION is silently a warning on non-Qwen3.5 attention; no KV quantization for Gemma/Qwen4

weight_quant_on_load.why: same (bf16 Gemma/Qwen4 checkpoints are the case it was made for)

prefill_kernels.why: Dense Qwen3.5 prefill is not wired into Qwen4 HC/MoE layers. Expert batching and invariant prefill qualification remain open.

apc_prefix_cache.why: Qwen4 hybrid caches are on the shared runner; same-checkpoint hit/miss gate remains required.

prefill_stride_rule.why: Flash-Next prefill is not split-invariant, so its APC checkpoints use the 2048 grid and semantic boundaries a cold run also splits at; turn-2 hit == cold bit-exact at 32K

draft_family_coverage.why: native MTP head rows and DFlash2 rows (the default when a matching drafter is on disk) are driver rows: per-row ring, one batched drafter forward, chains verified through the packed Flash-Next step

lane_promotion.why: there is no lane to promote from: every Flash-Next text row is a driver row

next_turn_rehearsal.why: The preemption wrapper targets Qwen3.5 decoder layers; Qwen4 needs its PLE/QSA/GDN snapshot contract before reuse.

docs_ask.why: Console request preparation only; delegates unchanged chat inference to the attached engine.

ane_ffn_split.why: The ANE split patches a dense Qwen3.5 MLP. Routed experts need routing-aware offload and a separate bandwidth/accuracy gate.

ngram_spec.why: Flash-Next rows run the packed layer (flashnext.py / flashnext_dflash.py), not the generic layer; ngram_ok requires self.generic, and the packed windows are batch-invariant MTP / DFlash verifies where a second host proposer would break spec on == spec off

draftlm_spec.why: Flash-Next rows run the packed layer (flashnext.py / flashnext_dflash.py), not the generic layer; ngram_ok requires self.generic, and the packed windows are batch-invariant MTP / DFlash verifies where a second host proposer would break spec on == spec off

gemma4_assistant_spec.why: Flash-Next rows run the packed layer (flashnext.py / flashnext_dflash.py), not the generic layer; ngram_ok requires self.generic, and the packed windows are batch-invariant MTP / DFlash verifies where a second host proposer would break spec on == spec off

modality_columns._doc: Feature x modality audit (phase E0). Columns: image / video (Qwen3.5-family dense VLM, VLMEngine -> round driver packed layer via prepare_media; video frames ride the image path), audio_in (same family; no audio encoder upstream, so every cell but media_input is na), omni_speech (Qwen3-Omni Thinker + Talker through omni_engine.py, bypasses the driver), ocr (OCREngine, ocr_engine.py, stock mlx-vlm generate). Every feature has a cell in every column. engaged needs ev (file + grep string that occurs in the file) and real_check (TODO until the lead's real-server run). missing / partial need owner and impact and why. na needs a physical reason. Unverified means missing. Source: lead/phaseE_plan.md E0, lead/bypass_census_1109.md.

cost_aware_depth.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no drafter depth control

sampled_spec.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no speculative sampling

guided_spec.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no guide on the OCR path

logprobs.why: OCREngine returns text and token counts only; no logprobs

penalties_in_spec.why: no penalty or logit_bias processors on OCREngine

spec_under_concurrency.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); OCREngine has no concurrency control

batch_invariant_kernels.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no spec path to make identical

lane_linear.why: Qwen3.5 layout lane matmul; GLM-OCR is a different architecture

lane_layers.why: Qwen3.5 verifier patch; GLM-OCR has no Qwen3.5 layers

ragged_kv.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); single request per call

kv_precision.why: YUNSHU_KV_PRECISION is not read on OCREngine

weight_quant_on_load.why: OCREngine loads through mlx_vlm.load with no YUNSHU_QUANT_* applied

prefill_kernels.why: Qwen3.5 GDN prompt kernels are not on GLM-OCR; no OCR prefill kernels installed

apc_prefix_cache.why: no prefix cache: every call prefills its image

prefill_stride_rule.why: no checkpoints, so no stride rule

media_input.why: one image per call, passed to mlx-vlm generate as [image_path]; not prepare_media, not a driver row; video and audio are not OCR inputs

draft_family_coverage.why: no drafter family is reachable from OCREngine

idle_memory_return.why: IdleMemory is wired on the VLM runner only; OCREngine clears memory at unload

cancel.why: router disconnect guard returns early but no cancel event reaches the generate call; generation runs to max_tokens=4096

ple_ssd_rows.why: PLE tables exist only in qwen4_exp (Flash-Next)

lane_promotion.why: single stock generate call with no shared batch

next_turn_rehearsal.why: rehearsal is a VLMEngine feature; not on OCREngine

gc_policy.why: GC policy is installed for the VLM runner only

grammar_prewarm.why: grammar prewarm is run by VLMEngine only

special_token_text.why: the task / language text is inserted into the prompt without neutralize_special_text

generation_suppress_default.why: generation_config suppress_tokens is not applied on the OCR path

sdpa_chunk_pre_nax.why: sdpa_chunk is not installed on OCREngine

pil_channels_last.why: fix is for the Gemma 4 / EmbeddingGemma 2 image processors; the GLM-OCR processor is not on that path

budget_marker_strip.why: no adapt_messages on the OCR path

docs_ask.why: console request preparation only; not a modality

ane_ffn_split.why: patches the Qwen3.5 dense MLP; GLM-OCR is a different architecture

ngram_spec.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no n-gram speculation

draftlm_spec.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no draft-LM speculation

gemma4_assistant_spec.why: driver-only feature: OCREngine calls mlx-vlm generate directly, not the round driver (bypass census B1); no Gemma-4 assistant speculation
